description: Trusted A2Game reference implementation for state.set

payloadSchema.description: Rule effect syntax and committed-state semantics are documented in extensions.publicSemantics; this open metadata object does not authorize arbitrary extra GameSpec effect fields.

publicSemantics.effect: In a GameSpec rule do array, use the effect object {op:"state.set",path:<JSON pointer>,value:<JSON literal or valid expression>}; path and value are top-level effect fields, not a nested payload. The rule must declare the state-set capability and its dependencies in requires. Only op/path/value are accepted for this effect.
publicSemantics.path: path addresses an existing value under a declared global state field, for example /<field>; it is not a Runtime observation /state prefix and cannot create an undeclared field or missing nested target. The resulting root value must still satisfy its declared type and constraints.
publicSemantics.value: value is required and may be null or any valid JSON literal, or an expression accepted by the GameSpec expression contract. Expression-looking objects use expression semantics; use {const:<JSON value>} when a literal object would otherwise be interpreted as an expression. No arbitrary code is executed.
publicSemantics.timing: Rule conditions and right-hand-side expressions read the same immutable post-simulation S_sim for a Tick. Effects commit sequentially afterward in T8; a state.set cannot retroactively change physics or a shot already simulated in that Tick. A failed commit rolls back the staged Tick; this effect does not move a body or update an aim binding unless the author explicitly targets the appropriate declared state path.
